title: ShortSport: Auto-scroll, Comments & Sharing, Profile Navigation

requirements.summary: Add click-to-activate auto-scroll mode in ShortSportPage that automatically advances to the next video after the current video finishes playing
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking a video activates auto-scroll mode for that session
After the active video finishes playing, the page automatically scrolls to the next video
The next video begins playing and the same auto-scroll behavior continues
If there is no next video, auto-scroll stops gracefully
Auto-scroll does not trigger before the video has finished playing

file_operations.description: Add state to track auto-scroll activation (boolean flag). On video click, enable auto-scroll mode. Add an onEnded event handler to the <video> element that checks if auto-scroll is active; if so, programmatically scroll to the next video ref using scrollIntoView with smooth behavior. Ensure auto-scroll gracefully stops when reaching the last video in the feed.

requirements.summary: Add a comments section to each ShortSport item, reusing the existing CommentsSheet component and backend methods (addComment, getComments)
acceptanceCriteria: Each ShortSport item has a comment icon/button
Tapping the comment button opens a comments panel showing all existing comments for that post
Comments display the commenter's username/avatar and comment text
Authenticated users can type and submit a new comment
New comments appear immediately after submission (optimistic or refetch)
Comment count updates visibly on the ShortSport item

file_operations.description: Add a comment button overlay on each video (positioned bottom-right or near like button) with an icon and comment count badge. Import and render the existing CommentsSheet component (conditionally visible when a post is selected). Add state to track the currently open post for comments. On comment button click, set the selected post and open the CommentsSheet. Reuse the existing getComments and addComment hooks from useQueries.ts.

requirements.summary: Add a share button to each ShortSport item that opens a friend selector modal, allowing users to share the video/picture via the existing messaging system
acceptanceCriteria: Each ShortSport item has a share icon/button
Tapping share opens a modal or bottom sheet listing the current user's friends
The user can select one or more friends and confirm to share
The post is sent as a message to the selected friend(s) using the existing messaging system
A success confirmation is shown after sharing

file_operations.description: Create a new modal component that displays a list of the current user's friends using the useFriendsList hook. Render each friend with their avatar (using AvatarPlaceholder) and display name. Support multi-select checkboxes. Include a 'Send' button that calls the sendMessage backend method for each selected friend, passing the postId. Show a toast or inline success message after sharing completes. Accept postId as a prop.

Add a share button overlay on each video (positioned near like/comment buttons). Import and render the new ShareModal component. Add state to track which post is being shared. On share button click, open the ShareModal with the selected post's ID. After sharing completes, close the modal and show a brief confirmation (e.g., toast or temporary message).

requirements.summary: Display the poster's profile avatar and username as an overlay on each ShortSport item, navigating to their profile page on tap
acceptanceCriteria: Each ShortSport item displays the poster's avatar and display name as an overlay on the video/image
The avatar falls back to gradient initials if no profile picture is set (reusing AvatarPlaceholder component)
Clicking/tapping the avatar or name navigates to the poster's UserProfilePage
Navigation uses the poster's principal ID in the route (consistent with existing user profile routing)

file_operations.description: Add an overlay div positioned at the bottom-left of each video displaying the poster's avatar (using AvatarPlaceholder with the post's authorPrincipal and authorName) and the authorName/display name. Wrap the avatar and name in a clickable element that navigates to /profile/{authorPrincipal} using the router's navigate function. Ensure the overlay is z-indexed above the video but below interactive buttons (like, comment, share).
